QF.id: VI Depository and its Business Partners_24

question.text: Under PMLA, DPs must maintain records of cash transactions exceeding what amount?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under PMLA, prescribed transactions including all cash transactions of the value of more than Rs. 10 lakh or its equivalent in foreign currency must be maintained as records. The Trap: 'Rs. 5 lakh' is not the PMLA threshold for cash transaction record-keeping. Note: The Rs. 10 lakh threshold also covers a series of connected cash transactions within one calendar month under the PMLA record-keeping requirements.
